symptoms: Emails and notifications delayed by hours; queue depth growing.
log: ERROR consumer group 'notifications' lag=482113; rebalance loop detected
root_cause: [trigger: queue lag] Consumer max.poll.interval.ms too low; slow downstream provider caused constant rebalances.
fix: Raised max.poll.interval.ms and reduced batch size; scaled consumers from 3 to 6.

symptoms: Requests returning 504 and latency spiked to 30s right after a deploy.
log: ERROR HikariPool-1 - Connection is not available, request timed out after 30000ms
root_cause: [trigger: config push] DB connection pool size reduced in a config change pushed with the deploy.
fix: Rolled back the config to the previous pool size, then redeployed with a load-tested value.

symptoms: Checkout page slow; p95 latency doubled after release.
log: WARN N+1 query detected: 412 queries executed for single request
root_cause: [trigger: deploy] New feature caused an N+1 query pattern on the cart endpoint.
fix: Added eager loading for cart items and released a patch.

symptoms: Error rate jumped to 15% immediately after release.
log: java.lang.NullPointerException at OrderMapper.toDto(OrderMapper.java:88)
root_cause: [trigger: deploy] New release introduced a null dereference for orders without a shipping address.
fix: Rolled back to the previous release; hotfix added a null check and a regression test.

symptoms: Search results empty for all queries after config change.
log: ERROR ElasticsearchException: index 'products_v2' not found
root_cause: [trigger: config push] Config push pointed the service to a non-existent index alias.
fix: Restored the index alias in config and reloaded the service.

symptoms: Payments failing intermittently with upstream errors.
log: ERROR 503 from stripe-gateway: upstream connect error or disconnect/reset before headers
root_cause: [trigger: dependency outage] Third-party provider outage combined with no circuit breaker or retry backoff.
fix: Enabled fallback provider, added circuit breaker and exponential backoff.

symptoms: All HTTPS calls failing with certificate errors.
log: SSLHandshakeException: PKIX path validation failed: certificate expired
root_cause: [trigger: certificate expiry] TLS certificate expired because auto-renewal job had been silently failing.
fix: Issued and installed a new certificate manually; fixed the renewal job and added expiry alerts.

symptoms: Intermittent failures resolving internal service hostnames.
log: java.net.UnknownHostException: payments-api.internal
root_cause: [trigger: dns] CoreDNS pods overloaded after a traffic surge; ndots setting caused excess lookups.
fix: Scaled CoreDNS replicas and tuned ndots and DNS caching.
